english.text: I am a linguaphile. Amongst the identities that I assume are being a "Japino" and being a "Mexipino" too. I cherish native cultures and languages around this world from the Arctic to the Pacific to the Amazon to the Oz Outback. I think that imagination is very important. I read and watch speculative fiction in a rainbow of languages. I watch anime. My religious stance is Syncretic, with a leaning towards Eastern.

jyutping: ngo5 hai6 jat1 go3 jyu5 jin4 oi3 hou3 ze2。ngo5 gaa2 cit3 ge3 san1 fan2 dong1 zung1 baau1 kut3 zou6「jat6 bun2 jan4」tung4 maai4 zou6「mak6 sai1 go1 jan4」。ngo5 hou2 zan1 sik1 ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 ge3 jyun4 zyu6 man4 man4 faa3 tung4 jyu5 jin4，jau4 bak1 gik6 dou3 taai3 ping4 joeng4，dou3 aa3 maa5 seon3 dou3 ou3 zi1 noi6 luk6，ngo5 gok3 dak1 soeng2 zoeng6 lik6 hai6 hou2 zung6 jiu3 ge3，ngo5 wui6 jung6 coi2 hung4 ge3 jyu5 jin4 heoi3 tai2 tung4 tai2 tau4 gei1 siu2 syut3 hai6 hap6 tai2，jau5 jat1 go3 king1 hoeng3 dung1 fong1。
text: 我係一個語言愛好者。我假設嘅身份當中包括做「日本人」同埋做「墨西哥人」。我好珍惜呢個世界嘅原住民文化同語言，由北極到太平洋，到亞馬遜到奧茲內陸，我覺得想像力係好重要嘅，我會用彩虹嘅語言去睇同睇投機小說係合體，有一個傾向東方。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: I must not stay to notice the strange fortunes of all the many other quasi-human worlds. I will mention only that in some, though civilization was destroyed in a succession of savage wars, the germ of recovery precariously survived. In one, the agonizing balance of the old and the new seemed to prolong itself indefinitely. In another, where science had advanced too far for the safety of an immature species, man accidentally blew up his planet and his race. In several, the dialectical process of history was broken short by invasion and conquest on the part of inhabitants of another planet. These and other disaster, to be described in due course, decimated the galactic population of worlds.

jyutping: ngo5 jat1 ding6 m4 wui5 lau4 dai1 lai4 lau4 ji3 so2 jau5 kei4 taa1 hou2 do1 zeon2 jan4 leoi6 sai3 gaai3 ge3 kei4 gwaai3 wan6 hei3。ngo5 zi2 wui5 tai4 jat1 tai4，hai2 mau5 di1 zin3 zaang1 jap6 min6，seoi1 jin4 man4 ming4 hai2 jat1 lin4 cyun3 ge3 je5 maan4 zin3 zaang1 zung1 bei6 ceoi1 wai2，daan6 hai6 fuk6 sou1 ge3 kwan2 zi2 jing4 jin4 ngai4 him2 dei6 cyun4 wut6 gan2。hai2 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3，san1 gau6 ge3 tung3 fu2 ping4 hang4 ci5 fu4 mou4 haan6 kei4 gam2 jin4 coeng4 gan2。hai2 ling6 jat1 go3 dei6 fong1，fo1 hok6 ji5 ging1 zeon3 bou6 dak1 taai3 jyun5，wai6 zo2 jat1 go3 mei6 sing4 suk6 mat6 zung2 ge3 on1 cyun4，jan4 leoi6 m4 siu2 sam1 zaa3 wai2 zo2 keoi5 ge3 sing1 kau4 tung4 keoi5 ge3 zung2 zuk6。hai2 gei2 go3 si6 gin6 jap6 min6，lik6 si2 ge3 bin6 zing3 gwo3 cing4 jan1 wai6 ling6 jat1 go3 sing1 kau4 ge3 geoi1 man4 ge3 jap6 cam1 tung4 zing1 fuk6 ji4 bei6 daa2 po3。 ni1 di1 tung4 kei4 taa1 zoi1 naan6，jiu3 hai2 sik1 dong1 ge3 si4 hau6 miu4 seot6，saat3 sei2 zo2 sai3 gaai3 ge3 ngan4 ho4 hai6 jan4 hau2。
text: 我一定唔會留低嚟留意所有其他好多準人類世界嘅奇怪運氣。我只會提一提，喺某啲戰爭入面，雖然文明喺一連串嘅野蠻戰爭中被摧毀，但係復甦嘅菌子仍然危險地存活緊。喺其中一個，新舊嘅痛苦平衡似乎無限期噉延長緊。喺另一個地方，科學已經進步得太遠，為咗一個未成熟物種嘅安全，人類唔小心炸毀咗佢嘅星球同佢嘅種族。喺幾個事件入面，歷史嘅辯證過程因為另一個星球嘅居民嘅入侵同征服而被打破。 呢啲同其他災難，要喺適當嘅時候描述，殺死咗世界嘅銀河系人口。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: As soon as he began to get near to the wood, all the great trees, the bushes, and brambles gave way of themselves to let him pass through. He walked up to the castle which he saw at the end of a large avenue; and you can imagine he was a good deal surprised when he saw none of his people following him, because the trees closed again as soon as he had passed through them.

jyutping: keoi5 jat1 hoi1 ci2 kaau3 gan6 muk6 tau4，so2 jau5 daai6 syu6、gun3 muk6 tung4 syu6 zi1 dou1 fong3 hei3 zo2 bei2 keoi5 gwo3 heoi3。keoi5 haang4 soeng5 heoi3 go3 sing4 bou2 dou6，keoi5 gin3 dou3 go3 sing4 bou2 hai2 jat1 tiu4 daai6 gaai1 ge3 mei5 dyun1；ji4 nei5 ho2 ji5 soeng2 zoeng6 dou2 keoi5 gin3 dou3 keoi5 di1 jan4 mou5 jan4 gan1 zyu6 keoi5 go2 zan6，keoi5 wui5 hou2 ging1 ngaa6，jan1 wai6 keoi5 jat1 ging1 gwo3 di1 syu6 zau6 jau6 saan1 maai4。
text: 佢一開始靠近木頭，所有大樹、灌木同樹枝都放棄咗畀佢過去。佢行上去個城堡度，佢見到個城堡喺一條大街嘅尾端；而你可以想像到佢見到佢啲人冇人跟住佢嗰陣，佢會好驚訝，因為佢一經過啲樹就又閂埋。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's the 18th of May of 2025. After 20:00, I headed walking to Tim Hortons café to enjoy an Orange Pekoe Tea with oat milk. In my lime green sack with a green lizard image thereon, I brought two books to the café to read, one Esperanto, one Interlingua: Tra Lando de Indianoj, by Tibor Sekelj, and Contos in Interlingua, by Sven Frank. Green and Blue, they are. The Esperanto book is a tale about life in the jungles of Red Indians in Brazil. The Interlingua book is a collection of children's tales. It was still before sunset. Arriving home, I saw that family Filipino friends Perlita and Glenn were talking to Mama in the dining room. They brought a fruit tray that includes red watermelon chunks, grape bunches, orange slices, etc. They brought also Philippine spaghetti and Philippine pancit noodles. We talked about rich chains like Tim Hortons, 7-Eleven, A&W, etc. and how so high the rental is for retail stores on Lulu Island, so that two 7-Eleven stores have closed in our neighbourhood; they stood for over 40 years!

jyutping: gam1 jat6 hai6 2025 nin4 5 jyut6 18 hou6。20 dim2 gwo3 hau6，ngo5 haang4 heoi3 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 gun2，hoeng2 jung6 jat1 bui1 caang2 baak6 faa1 coi3 pui3 maai4 jin3 mak6 naai5。hai2 ngo5 go3 sek6 fui1 luk6 sik1 doi6 jap6 min6，doi6 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 fuk1 luk6 sik1 sik1 jik6 ge3 tou4 zoeng6，ngo5 daai3 zo2 loeng5 bun2 syu1 heoi3 gaa3 fe1 teng1 tai2，jat1 bun2 hai6 sai3 gaai3 jyu5，jat1 bun2 hai6 gaan1 jyu5：dai3 bok3 · sak1 hak1 ji5 ge3《jan3 dai6 on1 nok6 zi1 laan4 do1》，tung4 maai4 si1 man4 · fat1 laan4 hak1 ge3《jan3 dai6 on1 jyu5 ge3 hung2 tok3 si1》。luk6 sik1 tung4 laam4 sik1，keoi5 dei6 hai6。sai3 gaai3 jyu5 syu1 hai6 jat1 go3 gwaan1 jyu1 baa1 sai1 hung4 jan3 dai6 on1 jan4 ge3 cung4 lam4 sang1 wut6 ge3 gu3 si6。 Interlingua ge3 syu1 hai6 jat1 bun2 ji4 tung4 gu3 si6 zaap6。dong1 si4 zung6 hai6 jat6 lok6 zi1 cin4。faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2，ngo5 gin3 dou2 uk1 kei2 jan4 ge3 fei1 leot6 ban1 pang4 jau5 Perlita tung4 Glenn hai2 caan1 teng1 tung4 maa1 mi4 king1 gan2 gai3，keoi5 dei6 daai3 zo2 go3 seoi2 gwo2 tok3 pun2，jap6 min6 jau5 hung4 sik1 sai1 gwaa1 faai3、pou4 tou4 cyun3、caang2 pin3 dang2 dang2。keoi5 dei6 zung6 daai3 zo2 fei1 leot6 ban1 ji3 fan2 tung4 fei1 leot6 ban1 zin1 beng2 min6。ngo5 dei6 gong2 zo2 hou2 ci5 Tim Hortons 、 7-Eleven 、 A & W dang2 dang2 ge3 fu3 hou4 lin4 so2 dim3，tung4 maai4 lou6 lou6 dou2 ge3 ling4 sau6 dim3 zou1 gam1 jau5 gei2 gam3 gou1，so2 ji5 ngo5 dei6 leon4 gan6 ge3 loeng5 gaan1 7-Eleven dim3 pou3 ji5 ging1 saan1 zo2 mun4； keoi5 dei6 kei5 zo2 ciu1 gwo3 40 nin4！
text: 今日係2025年5月18號。20點過後，我行去 Tim Hortons 咖啡館，享用一杯橙白花菜配埋燕麥奶。喺我個石灰綠色袋入面，袋入面有一幅綠色蜥蜴嘅圖像，我帶咗兩本書去咖啡廳睇，一本係世界語，一本係間語：蒂博 · 塞克爾嘅《印第安諾之蘭多》，同埋斯文 · 弗蘭克嘅《印第安語嘅孔托斯》。綠色同藍色，佢哋係。世界語書係一個關於巴西紅印第安人嘅叢林生活嘅故事。 Interlingua 嘅書係一本兒童故事集。當時仲係日落之前。返到屋企，我見到屋企人嘅菲律賓朋友 Perlita 同 Glenn 喺餐廳同媽咪傾緊計，佢哋帶咗個水果托盤，入面有紅色西瓜塊、葡萄串、橙片等等。佢哋仲帶咗菲律賓意粉同菲律賓煎餅麵。我哋講咗好似 Tim Hortons 、 7-Eleven 、 A & W 等等嘅富豪連鎖店，同埋露露島嘅零售店租金有幾咁高，所以我哋鄰近嘅兩間7-Eleven 店舖已經閂咗門； 佢哋企咗超過40年！

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: On Friday, the Greenland official government website posted this comment: “We have a good cooperation with USA, and we see it as an expression of greater interest in investing in our country and the possibilities we offer. Of course, Greenland is not for sale. Because of the unofficial nature of the news, the Government of Greenland has no further comments.”

text: 喺禮拜五，格陵蘭政府官方網站發佈咗呢個評論：「我哋同美國有良好嘅合作，我哋認為呢個係對投資我哋國家同我哋提供嘅可能性有更大興趣嘅表達。當然，格陵蘭唔係出售。由於呢個消息係非官方性質，格陵蘭政府冇進一步評論。」
